rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a waterborne vessel generally larger than a boat.

example.jyutping: go2 zek3 syun4 ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 hoi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for sending a parcel to someone, usually by post or courier.

example.english: I’ll ship the parcel to you tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 jat6 gei3 go3 baau1 gwo2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for launching or releasing a product, service, issue, or software to customers.

example.english: The company will ship its new software next month.
example.traditional: 間公司下個月推出新程式。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 teoi1 ceot1 san1 cing4 sik1

rows.note: Use this when physically passing or handing an item to another person, as with ketchup.

example.english: Please ship the ketchup over to me.
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 dai6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 ke2 zap1

rows.note: Use this specifically when sending goods by water-borne transport rather than by land or air.

example.english: We need to ship this batch of goods to Canada by sea.
example.traditional: 呢批貨要用船運去加拿大。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 jiu3 jung6 syun4 wan6 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6

rows.note: Use this when the ship is a spaceship.

example.english: This ship will fly to Mars.
example.traditional: 呢隻太空船會飛去火星。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 taai3 hung1 syun4 wui5 fei1 heoi3 fo2 sing1

rows.note: Use this when the ship is an airship or other flying vessel.

example.english: The ship in the film can fly very fast.
example.traditional: 套戲入面嗰隻飛船飛得好快。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 go2 zek3 fei1 syun4 fei1 dak1 hou2 faai3
